items.title: John Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Clearwater Beach and I’m very pleased to have bassist John Lamb with me here today. [INTERVIEWEE] Thank you.

ctx.x: Bassist John Lamb was born in Vero Beach, Florida on December 4, 1933. His diverse path in life has included a stint in the Air Force, performing with Duke Ellington, teaching in public school, and a return to the jazz arena.
John was interviewed in Clearwater Beach, Florida on March 16, 2001, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Hamilton College Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Clearwater Beach and I’m very pleased to have bassist John Lamb with me here today.
